# awscc_translate_terminology (Resource)

A custom terminology resource for Amazon Translate that enables customized translations.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the custom terminology.

### Optional

- `description` (String) The description of the custom terminology.
- `encryption_key` (Attributes) The encryption key for the custom terminology. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--encryption_key))
- `merge_strategy` (String) The merge strategy for the custom terminology. Currently only OVERWRITE is supported.
- `tags` (Attributes List) Tags associated with the terminology. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))
- `terminology_data` (Attributes) The terminology data for the custom terminology being imported. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--terminology_data))

### Read-Only

- `arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the custom terminology.
- `created_at` (String) The time the terminology was created.
- `directionality` (String) The directionality of the terminology.
- `format` (String) The format of the terminology data.
- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.
- `last_updated_at` (String) The time the terminology was last updated.
- `size_bytes` (Number) The size of the terminology file in bytes.
- `source_language_code` (String) The source language code for the custom terminology.
- `target_language_codes` (List of String) The target language codes for the custom terminology.
- `term_count` (Number) The number of terms in the custom terminology.

<a id="nestedatt--encryption_key"></a>
### Nested Schema for `encryption_key`

Optional:

- `id` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the encryption key.
- `type` (String) The type of encryption key.


<a id="nestedatt--tags"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tags`

Optional:

- `key` (String) The key of the tag.
- `value` (String) The value of the tag.


<a id="nestedatt--terminology_data"></a>
### Nested Schema for `terminology_data`

Optional:

- `directionality` (String) The directionality of the terminology resource.
- `file` (String) The file containing the custom terminology data, base64-encoded.
- `format` (String) The data format of the custom terminology.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_translate_terminology.example
  identity = {
    arn = "arn"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the custom terminology

#### Optional

- `account_id` (String) AWS Account where this resource is managed
- `region` (String) Region where this resource is managed

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_translate_terminology.example
  id = "arn"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
$ terraform import awscc_translate_terminology.example "arn"
```
